preconditions.description: The number of possible splits m must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of different monster types n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= mi <= n for mi in monster_ids) and all(li > 0 for li in split_counts)
preconditions.description: Each monster ID must be between 1 and n, and each split count must be positive.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= smallest <= 314000000 and 0 <= largest <= 314000000 for smallest, largest in results)
postconditions.description: The smallest and largest number of diamonds for each monster must be between 0 and 314,000,000.

postconditions.expression: all((smallest == -1 and largest == -1) or (smallest >= 0 and largest >= 0) for smallest, largest in results)
postconditions.description: If no diamonds can be collected, both smallest and largest must be -1.

postconditions.expression: all(largest == -2 or largest <= 314000000 for smallest, largest in results)
postconditions.description: If an arbitrarily large number of diamonds can be collected, the largest must be -2.
